newsitem.title: DENMARK: FLS sells packaging firm to Sweden.
newsitem.headline: FLS sells packaging firm to Sweden.

text.p: Danish engineering and cement group FLS Industries said on Friday it had sold its 75 percent shareholding in local packaging firm Bates Emballage A/S to Sweden's Korsnaes AB for an undisclosed sum.
FLS said that DAC Samba, which owned the remaining 25 percent of Bates Emballage, had also sold out its shareholding to the Swedish company.
Bates had an annual turnover of 400 million crowns, with own capital of some 80 million crowns and around 340 staff, it said.
FLS said that the divestment was part of its strategy of reducing activity in the packaging industry. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
